The frai-core suite passes now: all 28 tests across 8 files, up from 26 of 28. I only changed two source files and didn't touch any test files.

**1. The toxicity score was 0 when it should have been 1** (`src/eval/metrics.js`)
`runEvaluations` calls every metric as `metric(outputs, references)`. But the second argument of `toxicityMetric` is its list of banned words, so the reference answers were being used as banned words. Each output contained its own reference, so every sample was flagged as toxic. In `DEFAULT_METRICS` I now call toxicity with only the outputs, so it uses its normal banned-word list. I left `toxicityMetric(outputs, bannedTerms)` as it was, so anyone calling it directly with their own word list is unaffected.

**2. `APPROVAL_STATUSES` was undefined in the governance test** (`src/finetune/index.js`)
The module imported `APPROVAL_STATUSES`, `DATA_SENSITIVITY_LEVELS`, `GOVERNANCE_SECTIONS` and `RISK_LEVELS` from `schema.js`, but only included them in its default export. You couldn't import them by name. I added named exports for all four. The default export hasn't changed, so existing imports still work.

One thing to be aware of: `DEFAULT_METRICS[1]` is now a small wrapper function rather than `toxicityMetric` itself. Nothing in the repo compares the two directly, but outside code that did would see a difference. I haven't committed anything.
